p: The greatest hits: Iron Man → The Avengers → The Winter Soldier → Guardians of the Galaxy → Infinity War → Endgame → No Way Home → Deadpool & Wolverine.
Watch everything in the order it premiered, from 2008 on. That's how the story was meant to unfold, with every surprise intact.
Follow the in-universe timeline: start with Captain America: The First Avenger (1940s) and Captain Marvel (1990s), then move forward.
Skip the R-rated and darker entries: the Avengers films, Guardians, Ant-Man, Spider-Man, Black Panther, Captain Marvel.
Endgame → Loki S1–2 → No Way Home → Multiverse of Madness → Deadpool & Wolverine → Thunderbolts* → Fantastic Four.
Every film and series in timeline order, including the animated What If…? branches.
